name: terminal/git-review
title: Review a repository
summary: Review what changed in a repository: status, diff, log, risky files, then a summary.
when: Use when the user asks what changed in a repository or wants a check before committing.
steps: Call git action status with the repository path to see changed, untracked and staged files in one view.
Call git action diff for the unstaged changes and read every hunk before forming an opinion.
Call run_command with git diff --stat and git diff -- path when the full diff is too long to read at once.
Call git action log with limit 10 to see whether the change matches the recent work and its messages.
Mark risky changes: secrets or keys, dependency lock files, database migrations and edits outside the stated scope.
Call grep_files with patterns such as password, token and secret over the changed paths to catch a key before committing.
Call git action compare with the remote to say whether the branch is level, ahead or behind origin.
Summarise what changed, what looks risky and what to check before committing, in three short parts.
next: The final answer must summarise the changed files, the diff in plain words, the risky spots and whether the branch matches its remote.
